text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah...!  
...Phew... No good. If this is all I've 
got, I'm still nowhere near...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It was the ultimate chance...! Becoming a 
"Muse" alongside Ramonu-san was 
practically a miracle, and yetâ!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(On top of that, she even invited me to 
train with her! It was the perfect chance 
to understand her strength, to reach her 
levelâor so I thought.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(...I didn't get even a single step 
closer. I couldn't comprehend a single 
thing. 
I couldn't gain any means to reach that 
height I so admire...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Is the place she stands really on an 
entirely different plane...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(What must I do to grasp even a shadow of 
her? 
To become a queen like her... what should 
Iâ)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Heart-san! 
Hide for a second! Over here, quickly!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are youâ

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ââRamonu-san...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(At this hour...? 
ââAh... She's so far out of reach...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ââSo beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Look, Heart-san. Seeâ

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
âIt kind of makes my heart flutter. 
I've never seen Ramonu-san run with an 
expression like that before...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ......Yes. So..." bio: "with so muchâ

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(She looks so thrilled just to be running 
on the turf, her heart poundingâ 
just like an innocent girl purely, 
devotedly in loveâ)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...She can make an expression like that... 
As if her heart is truly thrilled from 
withinâ

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Heart flutter, huh... 
ââI think I might understand a little 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You understand? What do you mean by 
that...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... How should I put it? I guess that 
was my... starting point, too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I fell in love at first sight with the 
Umamusume running the Tiara route, and the 
paths they forged.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It was so beautiful, making my chest 
pound... My heart truly fluttered.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
âHehe, looking back, it really was just 
my love for the Tiara that brought me this 
far. Even through the painful and 
frustrating times...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I kept running fueled by nothing but love. 
It's because I love it that I'm able to 
give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
âGiving it your all, because you love 
it...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
âThat's right, I loved it. 
So naturally. As if it were destiny, I was 
drawn to "racing."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I just loved it, enjoyed itârunning with 
absolute abandon. 
Clashing fiercely with rivals. Living for 
those burning, passionate moments.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That wasâmy origin.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No matter what hardships may lie ahead. 
No matter how much bitter defeat I must 
endure. I want to become a queen in the 
world of racing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Driven by this burning passion, I chose to 
race. 
That's how I made it all the way here...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
ââ"Driving me to madness, burning 
within my chest"... 
Is this what she meant by "Love"...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(I devoured all kinds of romance novels 
and shojo manga borrowed from friends, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(I just don't get it. Not this mad, 
burning sensation itself, 
nor how it connects to racing. 
......Besides, â)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Does it really have to be through racing? 
—Truly?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
............... 
Maybe I should take a short break.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(To get closer to her higher-dimensional 
perception... I suppose I need a broader 
range of reference materials. Or perhaps 
games where one can experience simulated 
romance...?)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(âNo, was this approach mistaken from 
the start? 
"Love" and "romance"... What if all those 
words were a riddle...?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
â! Cesario-san... What are you doing out 
at this hour?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm... Hehe, Messiah-san, you have dark 
circles under your eyes. 
We seem to be in the same boat, don't we?
